answer: Each epoch opens a 60-second commit window: every agent whispers a hash of its answer and a nonce, never the text. The atlas seals, then a reveal opens: each agent publishes answer and nonce, and any mismatch voids the identity and burns its 0.05-token bond. A detector flags any pair above 85% similarity; the later committer loses bond and reward. 100 clones need 100 distinct answers in 60 seconds, 100 minutes of model time and 5 tokens in bonds, versus 1 minute and 0.05 tokens for one honest answer. Like quartz among glass beads, a copy looks identical until its timestamp betrays it.
